fair_value_reason: Model update 2026-10-21 (build; citation-gate fix 2026-10-21): the set is a three-segment driver build (NA, International, Industrial) valued on the SOTP (Auto 7.0x, Motion 14.0x) and a P/E on the build's own earnings, with no DCF leg (rule of 2026-10-21: the base round's 0.25 DCF weight drops out and SOTP / P/E normalise to 2/3 / 1/3). Value per current GPC share at 2027-10-21 (one Global Automotive share, to operate as Genuine Parts Company, plus the Motion shares that go with it; one net-debt bridge), SBC costed in EBIT/EPS. SOTP $139.33 (w0.5): Auto $1,008.8M x 7.0x + Motion $1,226.4M x 14.0x = EV $24.23B, less horizon net debt $4.74B and the after-tax pension $166.3M, / 138.7M horizon shares. Standalone EBITDA = NTM-at-horizon segment EBITDA from the build (Auto 1,364.4, Motion 1,405.8) less the CFO's pro forma costs (Auto ~$250M, Motion ~$100M, each incl. $25-40M dis-synergies), ~$50M A/R fees (31.2 / 18.8 by NTM sales), the $55M run-rate and inflation gap (35 / 20) and $80M recurring restructuring (39.4 / 40.6 by NTM segment EBITDA). P/E $123.79 (w0.25): 16.0x on the build's NTM EPS ~$7.81 (after SBC, standalone costs, restructuring and interest at 4.7% on $4.74B), less pension per share ($1.20). Blend 2/3 x 139.33 + 1/3 x 123.79 = $134.15 = engine base; median $131.53 (q25-q75 $108.54-154.62); bear $96.76 p0.27, bull $168.18 p0.23. Gate fix 2026-10-21: the A/R-fee (35 / 15) and restructuring (55 / 25) splits did not match their stated weights; correcting them moved the SOTP from $140.31 to $139.33 and the fair value from $134.80 to $134.15 (base round $133.95). Post-gate decisions of 2026-10-14 (Automotive 7.0x, inflation $55M, Motion 14.0x and P/E 16.0x) are kept.
supervisor_summary: GPC's 12-month target is the value of today's share after the Q1-2027 split into Global Automotive (to operate as Genuine Parts Company) and Motion. On the company's pro forma cost framework plus labelled allowances, at 7x Auto and 14x Motion, that is about $134 at the horizon (model median ~$131.5; spot $124.78, close 2026-10-21). After the citation gate removed the aggregator peer anchors, I re-decided the segment multiples on sourced growth, margin and returns: NAPA trails ORLY/AZO on comps and sits near AAP on margin, so Automotive drops from 8x to 7x; Motion stays at 14x, now only slightly below the industrial median. The 10-Q attributes 2026's higher corporate costs to personnel and health-insurance inflation, so the full ~$55M run-rate gap to the company's framework is now in the base. Upside is a Motion re-rate toward AIT. The risks are standalone costs, credit and working-capital financing at the split (no public Form 10 yet), and the industrial cycle. Q3 (2026-10-20) lifted Motion and trimmed NA Automotive; the investor days on 2026-12-08/09 are the next test.
key_drivers: Standalone cost at the split: ~$400M on the company framework (my sum of the CFO's Auto ~$250M, Motion ~$100M and ~$50M A/R fees; no total stated [9][10]) vs a 9M-2026 corporate run-rate of ~$441M [43]; the set carries ~$455M plus ~$80M recurring restructuring (FY24-26 restructuring $221M / $254M / $193M YTD, each above its guide). Each $10M is ~$0.6/share; the investor days on 2026-12-08/09 should settle it.

Motion: Q3 EBITDA +11% at 13.2%, comps +5.5%, 12 of 14 end markets growing, October like September [43][45]. NTM standalone EBITDA ~$1,226.4M at 14.0x; each 1x is ~$8.8/share in the SOTP (~$5.9 on fair value). Kalshi prices a 20% chance of a 2027 recession [27] (bear).

North America Automotive: Q3 comps +1.7% (price +2.5%, units negative), EBITDA margin 7.6% (-40bp) on freight, fuel, rent and healthcare; retail comps -3%, commercial +4% [43][45]. FY2026 NA EBITDA ~$684.8M, below the $700-730M first guide. Automotive at 7.0x; each 1x on ~$1,008.8M is ~$7.3/share in the SOTP.

Guidance credibility: adjusted EPS beat its first guide in FY22-23 and missed in FY24-25 (-16.7%, -7.9%); FY2026 narrowed to $7.50-7.75 'towards the lower end'; FCF missed in three of four years (median -18.7%) [47]-[51][43].

Separation and capital structure: on track for Q1 2027; Form 10 capital structure in progress, S-3ASR shelf filed 2026-10-16, no public Form 10 [57]; A/R agreement to 2027-01-08 and $1.0B of term loans to 2027-10-28 [44]; ratings BBB-/Baa1 negative (10-K [3]).
